resources.string: A short nap, with a voice to wake you
A phone call, another app’s sound or low media volume can keep the wake-up from being heard. Before a shift, or any nap you must not oversleep, set your phone’s own alarm too.
Soft noise, then your device’s voice wakes you
Preparing… The first time takes a little while.
This nap is no longer available
Could not prepare the nap. Check that your device has an English text-to-speech voice, then tap play to try again.
Lie down as soon as you press play: the time includes falling asleep.
Turn your media volume up enough to hear the voice.
Before a night shift, a nap in the late afternoon or early evening helps you stay alert.
Short naps leave you less groggy. If you wake slowly, give yourself a few minutes before driving.
Published studies find naps of 10 to 20 minutes improve alertness with little grogginess afterwards. This is not a medical treatment.
